mapper.select: SELECT id, book_id, candidate_id, knowledge_entity_id, name, narrative_role, chat_enabled, reviewed FROM character WHERE book_id = #{bookId} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM knowledge_entity WHERE reference_type = 'ENTITY_CANDIDATE' AND reference_id = #{candidateId}
mapper.update: UPDATE entity_candidate SET recommended_role = #{role}, role_recommendation_reason = #{reason} WHERE id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE entity_candidate SET review_status = #{status}, merged_into_candidate_id = #{targetId} WHERE id = #{candidateId}
UPDATE knowledge_entity SET review_status = #{status} WHERE reference_type = 'ENTITY_CANDIDATE' AND reference_id = #{candidateId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO character (book_id, candidate_id, knowledge_entity_id, name, narrative_role, chat_enabled) VALUES (#{bookId}, #{candidateId}, #{knowledgeEntityId}, #{name}, #{role}, #{chatEnabled}) ON CONFLICT (candidate_id) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, narrative_role = EXCLUDED.narrative_role, chat_enabled = EXCLUDED.chat_enabled, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM character_alias WHERE character_id = (SELECT id FROM character WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO character_alias (character_id, alias, source_type) SELECT c.id, em.mention_text, MIN(em.source_type) FROM character c JOIN entity_mention em ON em.entity_candidate_id = c.candidate_id WHERE c.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND LOWER(em.mention_text) != LOWER(c.name) GROUP BY c.id, em.mention_text ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM knowledge_entity WHERE reference_type = 'ENTITY_CANDIDATE' AND reference_id = #{candidateId}
mapper.update: UPDATE extracted_fact SET subject_candidate_id = #{targetId} WHERE subject_candidate_id = #{sourceId}

WITH ids AS ( SELECT (SELECT id FROM knowledge_entity WHERE reference_type='ENTITY_CANDIDATE' AND reference_id=#{sourceId}) source_ke, (SELECT id FROM knowledge_entity WHERE reference_type='ENTITY_CANDIDATE' AND reference_id=#{targetId}) target_ke ), deleted_self AS ( DELETE FROM knowledge_relation kr USING ids WHERE (kr.source_entity_id=ids.source_ke AND kr.target_entity_id=ids.target_ke) OR (kr.source_entity_id=ids.target_ke AND kr.target_entity_id=ids.source_ke) ), deleted_participants AS ( DELETE FROM event_participant source USING ids WHERE source.knowledge_entity_id=ids.source_ke AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM event_participant target WHERE target.event_id=source.event_id AND target.knowledge_entity_id=ids.target_ke AND target.participant_role=source.participant_role) ), moved_participants AS ( UPDATE event_participant ep SET knowledge_entity_id=ids.target_ke FROM ids WHERE ep.knowledge_entity_id=ids.source_ke ), moved_sources AS ( UPDATE knowledge_relation kr SET source_entity_id=ids.target_ke FROM ids WHERE kr.source_entity_id=ids.source_ke ) UPDATE knowledge_relation kr SET target_entity_id=ids.target_ke FROM ids WHERE kr.target_entity_id=ids.source_ke

UPDATE book SET status = CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM character WHERE book_id=#{bookId} AND chat_enabled=TRUE) = 1 THEN 'CHARACTERS_REVIEWED' ELSE 'KG_BUILT' END, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{bookId}
